//: Story Phase 3: Garrick and Squawks between set-pieces, and hints when an objective is waiting on them.
garrick.p3_log_hint: garrick[businesslike]: The Stench Log, Captain. On the crate. Read it with your eyes, not your nose.
garrick: Page one is the executive summary. It is also page two.
garrick.p3_notice_hint: garrick[pretend]: A notice? On the mainmast? I wouldn't know anything about a notice.
garrick: ...Although it IS very well written.
garrick.p3_taste_hint: garrick[delighted]: Have a mug, Captain! Mags is pouring. The crew are waiting for you to go first. Out of respect. And fear.
garrick.p3_confirm_hint: garrick[businesslike]: Check any bottle you like, Captain. The rum in your cabin. The Doc's brandy. Whatever the old man keeps in his locker.
garrick[smug]: You'll find the brand has been consolidated.
garrick.p3_rowboat_hint: garrick[nervous]: The rowboat, Captain. By the starboard davit. I'll be in it. With the beans.
garrick: Lower me gently. Beans are fragile. So am I, emotionally.
garrick.p3_damage_hint: garrick[smug]: Jory's doing the damage report, Captain. I'd listen with one ear. The other ear should be listening to how much of the ship is left.
garrick.p3_s9: garrick[proud]: One moment, Captain. The Grand— one moment. I'm composing.
garrick.p3_s10b: garrick[delighted]: Captain Stinkbeard! Magnificent. The name suits you. The name was MADE for you. By me.
garrick.p3_s11: garrick[delighted]: The grog is wonderful, Captain! Complex. Robust. It has legs.
garrick: It might literally have legs. Something moved in my mug.
garrick.p3_s12: garrick[businesslike]: The Grand Stenchmaster's morning inspection is ongoing, Captain. Report back when you've seen the sails, the ropes, the bell and the wood.
garrick[smug]: And talk to the crew. They've noticed things. I've noticed them noticing.
garrick.p3_s13: garrick[nervous]: I did mention the sharks, Captain. In my defence, I mentioned them last.
garrick.p3_s14_1: garrick[proud]: I'd like it noted that I came back, Captain. Voluntarily. More or less.
garrick: The oar did not come back. The oar was a casualty of the operation.
garrick.p3_s14_2: garrick[businesslike]: Shark-related stink emergencies are now a department, Captain. I am the department.
garrick: The department answers to you. The department is thrilled about it.
squawks.p3_s9: squawks[worried]: Captain. Why is Garrick standing on a barrel?
squawks[insulting]: Ask him. Then I'll bite him. Division of labour.
squawks.p3_s11: squawks[worried]: ...Captain? Stay a bit. Till I'm asleep.
squawks.p3_s12: squawks[worried]: The bell's got a cold, Captain. Like me.
squawks[furious]: My feathers were the first thing on this ship to go! Don't let it take the bell!
squawks.p3_s13: squawks[horrified]: SHARKS! Sharks don't eat parrots. Do sharks eat parrots? BALD parrots?
squawks[worried]: Bald parrots look like chickens. Sharks eat chickens.
squawks.p3_s14: squawks[insulting]: The shark had better taste. It let go.
squawks.p3_end_1: squawks[smug]: Golden feather. The captain said.
squawks.p3_end_2: squawks[insulting]: Grand Stenchmaster. More like Grand... Grand...
squawks.p3_end_3: squawks[smug]: DEADLY BREW drill! Deadly brew drill!
